summary_rationale: Eimco Elecon holds a 52-year, ~65-70% domestic share in intermediate underground coal loading machinery with a near debt-free balance sheet (₹488 Cr net worth, ~₹206 Cr liquidity as of Mar 2026) and a 202% YoY order-book rebound to ₹133 Cr as of Sep 2026. However, 75-80% revenue concentration in underground mining, lumpy tender-driven sales (FY26 -6.4% YoY), heavy working capital (211 inventory days, 115 debtor days, H1 FY27 CFO of ₹2 Cr), sub-12% ROE (8.6% in FY26), and governance watchpoints (Sandvik's Sep 2025 exit, Oct 2026 CFO resignation, and Dec 2025 unrelated MoA expansion) classify it as CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than a pure secular compounder.
